networkPurpose: Fetch only exact locked dependencies from their lockfile-resolved registries using existing configuration; no credential/account/configuration changes or paid services.
allowedWrites: Generated/ignored web/node_modules, build/test outputs and ordinary task-local/npm caches only, with platform filesystem approval if needed. No source, manifest, lockfile, CI, deployment, git configuration or existing evidence edits.
standardBuild: Exact npm run build required in supporting permitted environment; alternate command cannot waive it. Retain original build/IPC failures and new failures until actual resolution.
onFailure: Record exact command/result/limits; do not install substitutes, change scripts, bypass checks or silently broaden repair. Continue unaffected saved package work.
